$description: Signal — W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) export of tokens.json, for Tokens Studio, Figma variable import and Style Dictionary.

accent.$description: Signal Blue, the single accent. Primary buttons, links, active nav, section index, skill-bar fill, focus outline. As text: 7.96:1 on color-bg, 7.36:1 on color-surface, 6.77:1 on color-surface-2. Reserve for what the visitor can act on or must notice.

accent-hover.$description: Hover state for every accent surface (primary button, submit). color-text-on-accent on it reaches 10.11:1.

accent-dark.$description: Alternate accent for rules, dividers, large numerals and decorative fills. Exactly 4.50:1 on color-bg and 4.16:1 on color-surface, so never body copy and never text below 18px; on color-surface only at 24px and up.

accent-soft.$description: Badge and soft-button backgrounds (Tag, ServiceCard action, active Tab). Flattens to #1a222b on color-bg, #212a36 on color-surface. color-accent text on it: 6.02:1 or better.

accent-shadow.$description: Border of the current TimelineCard and of Tags. Decorative: the Current badge carries the meaning in words. Flattens to #304560 on color-bg.

bg.$description: Page background, the base layer (~70% of any screen). Also the ink of the wordmark on a Signal Blue field. Mobile theme-color must match it.

surface.$description: Cards, nav panels, the portrait backing (~20% with surface-2).

surface-2.$description: Inputs, skill-bar tracks, wells inside a card, skeleton base.

border.$description: Default 1px hairline between surfaces: card shells, nav bottom, footer top, section-heading rule. Decorative only (1.2:1 on color-bg).

border-strong.$description: Hover borders, input borders, outline button, skeleton highlight. Source value kept: 1.56:1 on color-bg is below the 3:1 non-text guideline, so a field is identified by its visible label, and focus turns the border color-accent.

text.$description: Headings and primary copy. 15.53:1 on color-bg, 14.37:1 on color-surface, 13.21:1 on color-surface-2 (AAA).

text-muted.$description: Body copy, nav links, meta. 7.65:1 on color-bg, 7.08:1 on color-surface, 6.51:1 on color-surface-2 (AAA on bg and surface).

text-faint.$description: Timestamps, captions, footer, percentages, empty states. 6.15:1 on color-bg, 5.69:1 on color-surface, 5.23:1 on color-surface-2 (AA).

text-on-accent.$description: Text and icons on a color-accent or color-accent-hover fill (primary button, submit, skip link): 7.96:1 and 10.11:1.

success.$description: Confirmation only, always with a word (Sent, DO). 11.00:1 on color-bg, 10.18:1 on color-surface.

error.$description: Validation errors only, always with a message (DO NOT, field errors). 6.42:1 on color-bg, 5.94:1 on color-surface. Differs from color-success by hue more than lightness (1.71:1), so never rely on the colour alone.

warning.$description: Offline banner and system-level warnings, as a fill or a rule. Source value kept: as text it is 3.82:1 on color-bg and 3.53:1 on color-surface (fails body text), and color-text on a warning fill is 4.07:1 (large or bold 19px+ only). Set warning copy in color-text beside a warning rule.

2.$description: Icon-to-label gap, label above field, skill-bar height.

3.$description: Section-heading gaps, button pairs, social icon gap, button vertical padding.

4.$description: Timeline logo gap, container padding at 720px and below, footer social gap.

5.$description: Card padding, container padding on desktop, skill-grid gap.

6.$description: Section heading to content, service-card padding, footer padding.

8.$description: Section padding on desktop; equals the nav height.

sm.$description: Buttons, inputs, focus outlines, skip link, timeline logos.

lg.$description: The hero portrait only; used nowhere else.

pill.$description: Skill-bar track and fill, Tags, social icons (with 50%). The manual writes it as a literal 999px; named here so it has one source.

container-width.$description: Maximum content width, centred, with space-5 gutters (space-4 at 720px and below).

nav-height.$description: Sticky nav height and the scroll-margin offset for section anchors.

hero-name.$description: The name in the hero, the only h1, in color-text.

section-heading.$description: Section titles (h2) inside SectionHeading, in color-text.

hero-role.$description: The animated role line under the hero name, in color-text-muted; reserves 28px min-height.

card-title.$description: Timeline, blog and contact card titles (h3), in color-text.

wordmark.$description: The wordmark in the nav, its working context. Never below 14px.

nav-link.$description: Nav links and tab labels in color-text-muted; color-accent on hover and when active.

button-label.$description: Button and submit labels, verb first.

section-index.$description: Two-digit section index with a leading zero, in color-accent.

eyebrow.$description: Uppercase, color-accent, always directly above the heading it introduces.

form-label.$description: Field labels in color-text-muted, 8px above the field.

meta.$description: Dates and meta in color-text-faint; the Current badge.

tagline.$description: The hero tagline in color-text-muted, capped at 520px.

body-sm.$description: Card meta, descriptions, excerpts, empty states (in color-text-faint).

input-text.$description: Text typed into inputs and textareas, in color-text.

footer-text.$description: Footer copyright and build credit, in color-text-faint.
